transcriber_notes: Rows: 140 officials (part 1) + 11 foreign advisers (part 2), read as printed; one row per name (lists of State Councillors, Standing Committee, Vice-Chairmen split one per row). No totals printed.
Organ = bold centred heading; Office = small-caps / roman sub-heading under it (blank when the official belongs directly to the organ).
Chinese names printed with each romanization; spacing between characters removed. Nationality/remark in part 2 taken from the parentheses as printed.
Academia Sinica, Secretary-General 'Ting Hsueh-lin': Chinese printed 林燮林 (first character 林, apparently a misprint for 丁) — kept as printed.
Ministry of Military Affairs, Administrative Vice-Minister 'Ch'en-Ch'eng': Chinese printed 陳介 (same as Ch'en Chieh above; apparently a misprint) — kept as printed.

Ministry of Navy, Political Vice-Minister 'Ch'en Chi-liann' (romanization as printed): third Chinese character damaged/ambiguous (resembles 良 or 頁; same unusual glyph as in 羅?鑑 'Lo Liang-chien', p. 528) — [illegible].
Ministry of Navy, Administrative Vice-Minister romanization printed 'Hsüg-yung' — kept as printed.
Ministry of Finance, Administrative Vice-Minister 'Hsu K'an': second character printed as 言 + 甚 (諶) — kept as seen.
Ministry of Audit, Administrative Vice-Minister 'Wang Si-t'ien': middle Chinese character unclear (right component 昔; left radical 糸/金/竹-type unclear) — [illegible].
Mongolian Local Autonomy Political Council, Vice-Chairman: sixth character of 德穆楚克棟魯布 printed small and blurred; read as 魯.
Executive Yuan Secretary-General Oong Wen-hao: first character faintly printed; read as 翁.
Office heading 'Adminstrative Court' misspelt as printed.
Inspector General of Customs and the Salt Administration's foreign Associate Directors-General have no Chinese names printed (cells empty).
Ministry of Audit (p. 526) is printed after the Control Yuan, at the top of p. 526, and is placed under Control Yuan here.

Shansi, Wang P'ing: printed 'Concurrently Commissioner of Reconstruction' although Fan Hsiang-li is also so styled (Finance is missing) — kept as printed.
Kwangtung heading printed without the opening parenthesis before 廣東省政府.
Chahar list prints So-no-mu-la-pu-t'an as 索諾木拉布坦 followed by a comma; Suiyuan prints 沙克都爾札巴 (巴, cf. 布 in the Suiyuan Mongol council list) — as printed.
Kiangsi, Wen Ch'un: printed 文郡; Shantung, Han Fu-chu: printed 韓復渠; Szechwan, Chi Tsu-yu: printed 稽祖佑 — kept as printed.
